description: A null argument is an error, even if the result doesn't use it
notes: The README and the package documentation don't say whether parameters accept null. hashicorp/hcl declares them without AllowNull (decodeUserFunctions in ext/userfunc/decode.go), so by the spec's call rules a null argument makes the call an error.
reference_error: Invalid value for "x" parameter: argument must not be null
